Curcumin BenefitsCurcumin is a yellow pigment and the main component in the popular spice turmeric. This compound is what gives turmeric many of its potential health benefits, which is why it is often extracted to be used in dietary supplements. Curcumin may help to increase the level of antioxidants in the body, and promote heart health, cognitive health, and joint health, which can help support an overall healthy lifestyle.*
California Gold Nutrition® Curcumin 95 contains curcumin extracted from turmeric root (Curcuma longa). When taken as directed, this provides a one-month supply.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Take 1 capsule daily, with food. Best when taken as directed by a qualified healthcare professional.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children. Pregnant or lactating women, the chronically ill, elderly, individuals under the age of 18, those taking prescription medications (e.g ., blood thinners) as well as those with a physician diagnosed medical condition should consult with a physician, pharmacist, naturopath or other qualified healthcare professional prior to taking dietary supplements.
Sealed for your protection. Do not use if seal is missing or broken. Store in a cool, dry place. Protect from heat, light, and moisture.
